How to Read These Charts

Healing is a decision-making game, so timing and attention are the real resources we all manage. This chart classifies healers by how their attention spreads and how active they were doing so.

X axis shows casts per minute, but normalized by global cooldowns (nCPM). A 3-second cast counts as 2 GCDs, a 1.5s Flash Heal counts as 1. This removes bias for slower casting playstyles.

Y axis shows the participation ratio, a measure of how many targets someone was actively healing (Neff). If a druid casts the same amount of spells on all forty players, N equals 40. If a paladin sticks to a tank 1000 times but spot-heals once or twice on other players, N equals 1.

Healers on the right are more active. Healers on the top are whack-a-moling across the raid.

💡 A good rule of thumb for a healthy Neff is: number of direct assignments plus 5.

Attention Spread and True Activity If your name is to the left, you can afford to be a bit more active. The higher you are on the Y axis, the more people you're actively healing back-to-back — a reminder to stay on your main assignment when it's healthy, but always fish for opportunities to save someone dipping below 50%. X: nCPM (normalized casts per minute, cost-weighted) · Y: Neff, the effective number of players a healer spread their healing across — low means focused on one or two targets, high means healing was spread evenly around the raid. Hover a point for True Activity: the % of the fight actually spent casting, independent of how that time was spread.

Estimated Mana Spent How much mana we spent throughout the run. Estimated mana used casting the spells counted in Effective Healing (rank × count × estimated mana cost, minus Inner Focus savings) — an estimate because, although our logs are advanced-logged, Classic Era log trackers don't record mana on events (to save CPU), so real mana spent, regen and MP5 aren't available. "% of highlighted" shows everyone relative to the healer picked in ✦ Highlight healer (= 100%).

Effective Healing per Mana How much effective healing we did for every point of mana spent. Effective healing amount ÷ estimated mana spent · higher = more efficient. This is the closest metric we can calculate to Miun's Healing Score — Effective Healing per Net Mana spent, aka Spell Cost minus Mana Regenerated: although our logs are advanced-logged, Classic Era log trackers don't record mana on events (to save CPU), so WarcraftLogs has no mana at cast time, spell cost or passive regeneration (mp2/MP5) to read.
